# AI 软件教程

> 章节机器阅读文件及正式讲解的定位链接。

每份公开 JSON 包含摘要、短答、来源网址与完整原始章节 HTML。短答不能替代配置细节与实测限制。

## 章节

- [对话与基础任务](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/index.ai.json) — 学习怎样向 AI 说明任务、提供必要材料、设置边界和提出可执行要求，并根据结果迭代提示词；配合原有交互流程、案例与常见问题继续练习。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/)
  - [提示词是不是越长越好？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
  - [向 AI 提需求时，应该补充哪些材料、边界和执行要求？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
  - [AI 的回答不符合要求时，怎样判断原因并修改提示词？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
- [一. 什么是 Agent？什么时候需要用到？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/index.ai.json) — 理解 AI Agent、模型与工作流的关系，认识行动和反馈循环，以及工具、知识、记忆的作用，判断何时需要 Agent、怎样设置自主性和权限。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/)
  - [AI Agent、模型和工作流有什么关系？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-1)
  - [Agent 为什么需要工具、知识、记忆和反馈？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-2)
  - [什么任务适合用 Agent，应该给它多大自主性和权限？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-4)
- [二. 如何制作 Agent？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/index.ai.json) — 从话题助手开始，学习为 Agent 配置知识库、跨对话记忆与语音交流，设置定时和事件触发的后台任务，并了解发布、维护与开源许可。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/)
  - [怎样制作基于自有知识库的话题助手？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/#course-agent-building-topic-1)
  - [怎样给 Agent 配置跨对话记忆和语音交流？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/#course-agent-building-topic-2)
  - [怎样安排 Agent 在后台运行，并处理无人值守和发布维护？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-building/#course-agent-building-topic-3)
- [三. 如何寻找 Agent](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/index.ai.json) — 分清 Agent、Skill 与 Harness 的作用，查找现成 Agent、技能、运行程序和工作流的具体资源入口，并了解各类资源在使用前需要核对的条件。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/)
  - [Agent、Skill 和 Harness 分别是什么？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/#course-agent-discovery-topic-1)
  - [去哪里寻找现成的 Agent 和可复用的 Skill？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/#course-agent-discovery-topic-2)
  - [怎样查找 Agent 运行程序和自动化工作流？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/#course-agent-discovery-topic-4)
- [四. 自动化工作流](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/index.ai.json) — 学习拆分工作流、分配模型与程序和人的职责、设计分支及检查反馈，并通过入职指南、邮件日程、客户咨询等十个案例理解完整处理路径。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/)
  - [什么情况下应该把任务拆成多个工作流步骤？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/#course-agent-automation-topic-1)
  - [怎样决定哪些步骤交给模型、程序或人处理？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/#course-agent-automation-topic-2)
  - [怎样设计条件分支、检查节点和反馈循环？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/automation/#course-agent-automation-topic-3)
- [五. 评分与改进系统](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/index.ai.json) — 认识四类评估工具，按 LangSmith 教学步骤准备测试集、设置评分、解读报告并比较提示词版本；保留课程对资料核对、演示结果和未完整试跑的说明。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/)
  - [AI Agent 的评估工具有哪些类型，怎样选择？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/#course-agent-evaluation-topic-1)
  - [怎样用 LangSmith 准备测试集、设置评分并查看报告？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/#course-agent-evaluation-topic-2)
  - [怎样区分回答错误与评分错误，并比较修改前后的提示词？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/#course-agent-evaluation-topic-3)
- [第一章 传统编程](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/index.ai.json) — 从明确问题、搜集信息、设计方法、编写运行到验证改进，理解编程的五个核心环节，并认识运行环境、程序结构、Git、测试与调试等重要技术。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/)
  - [完成一个编程任务通常要经过哪些环节？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/#coding-foundations-overview)
  - [运行环境、程序结构、Git、测试和调试分别解决什么问题？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/#coding-foundations-section-1)
  - [在使用 AI 编程前，应该先理解哪些基础技术？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-foundations/#coding-foundations-overview)
- [第二章 AI 如何助力传统编程](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/index.ai.json) — 沿着编程的五个核心环节，了解可直接使用的 Agent、Skill 和工具，学习让 AI 协助明确需求、搜集信息、设计程序、编写代码及定位和改进问题。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/)
  - [怎样让 AI 协助明确需求、搜集资料和设计程序？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/#coding-assistance-section-1)
  - [哪些 Agent、Skill 和工具可以用于编写与运行代码？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/#coding-assistance-section-4)
  - [怎样用 AI 帮助验证结果、定位错误并改进程序？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/ai-coding/coding-assistance/#coding-assistance-section-5)
- [第一章 专业图像生成与工作流](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-generation/index.ai.json) — 学习专业图像生成中的文生图、参考图、图生图、局部重绘与扩图，理解 ControlNet、LoRA 和参数对比，并查阅 Midjourney 与 Stable Diffusion 教程。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-generation/)
  - [文生图、参考图、图生图和局部重绘适用于什么任务？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-generation/#course-image-generation-section-3)

  - [怎样比较生成参数并保存可复用的图像工作流？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-generation/#course-image-generation-section-9)
- [第二章 使用 Agent 辅助操作 Photoshop](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/index.ai.json) — 比较 Photoshop 内置助手与外部 Agent 的接入方式，了解 UXP 插件和 Windows COM 两种 MCP 方案、连接验证、任务表达及常见接入问题。
  - [正式阅读页](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/)
  - [Photoshop 内置助手和外部 Agent 有哪些接入方式？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/#course-image-photoshop-agent-section-1)

  - [怎样确认连接成功，并排查 Agent 无法操作 Photoshop 的问题？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-photoshop-agent/#course-image-photoshop-agent-section-4)
- [第三章 寻找与复用现成工作流](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-workflow-reuse/index.ai.json) — 按人物一致性、商品重新布光、局部修改和图片放大，查阅 IP-Adapter FaceID、ComfyUI Inpainting 与 ESRGAN 案例，核对复用前的准备和结果记录。

  - [复用别人的图像工作流前，需要准备和记录什么？](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/image-creation/image-workflow-reuse/#course-image-workflow-reuse-section-5)
- [第一章 专业视频生成平台、基本介绍与教程](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/video-creation/video-generation/index.ai.json) — 分清视频模型、平台与工作流，了解即梦、通义万相和海螺的教程入口，学习提示词、参考素材、镜头运动及一致性等视频生成控制点。

- [第二章 使用 Agent 操作专业视频编辑平台](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/software/video-creation/video-editing-agent/index.ai.json) — 了解 DaVinci Resolve Studio 与 Adobe Premiere Pro 的 Agent 接入方式，核对版本和脚本条件，连接外部工具，并检查视频工程操作的结果及常见问题。
